label: Retrieval
description: Recall the sum directly from memory, without visibly executing a counting or derivation strategy. What unlocks skill.add_to_fluent -- the strategy-mediated skill is a prerequisite, since automaticity is understood as building on having solved it via strategy first, not a separate route to the answer.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
